ana_csm: Quick alert 124: AsterHealth onboarding 24h uptime 98.4% vs contract 99.5%. Need incident summary + provisional credit for renewal pack. @rowan_sre @eli_ops
rowan_sre: looking. I see a concentrated window ~03:1503:27 UTC with repeated 503s, autoscale lag suspected. Pulling traces now.
eli_ops: their dedicated pool burst factor was 1x. I can bump to 2x and run a prefix warmup, want me to roll that?
ana_csm: yes please. Also need p95/p99 and failed request count for the packet.
rowan_sre: quick numbers: 210 failed requests during window, p95 ~1.7s, p99 ~2.9s. Log snippet: `503 | pool | scale-miss | node=node-12`.
eli_ops: scaled pool at 03:22, warmup script started 03:25. Run command we used: `./tools/warmup --customer aster --top 30`.
lucy_pdm: Renewal call next Wed. If we show remediation + a clear credit calc it will help retention. Suggest a small goodwill credit.
ana_csm: Jamal usually drafts the one-pager but he's OOO. I'll draft and loop you in, Lucy. Need the credit calc: failed reqs, avg tokens, contract multiplier.
eli_ops: provisional calc: 210 * 320 tokens = 67,200 tokens. At $0.0004/token => $26.88. Contract multiplier 3x => $80.64. I'll confirm with billing.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1108  evidence bundle: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1108
rowan_sre: uploaded Grafana snapshots + raw traces to GDrive: https://gdrive.redwood/aster/INC-2026-1108
ana_csm: timeline + one-pager draft due EOD. Reconvene 3:30pm PT to finalize comms. Add blockers here.
